# ADR 0004: Configurable thresholds owned by compliance

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Sanctions screening service

## Context

False positives cost analyst time; false negatives are regulatory breaches.

## Decision

Externalise high/low thresholds via validated configuration; changes are reviewed like code.

## Consequences

Tunable without code changes; documented ownership.

## Alternatives considered

Hard-coded thresholds.
